outcome_blind_selection.selected_range: 408-433 matched admissions, 517.5-549.2 annualized, median 2 per active session, p95 4, maximum 6, busiest-session share below 1.5 percent

engine.initial_state: observe_only; only a subsequent turn_event may open risk

bounded_cells.ranking: discovery eligibility, positive quarter count, worst-quarter primary and stress net, stress net/intrabar-DD, stress PF, then primary net; validation cannot select

lifecycle.entry: next available MCL one-minute open after a completed CL turn, only when latest completed MCL five-minute move confirms direction
lifecycle.opposite_turn: close and flip at the same next MCL one-minute open
lifecycle.maintenance: retain position and state across the ordinary daily halt
lifecycle.roll: close old active MCL at its last close and reopen the same direction at the next matched-contract open; cost both legs and reset source state by suffix

fixed_owners.roll: dual prior-session CL/MCL volume cross, forced three complete sessions before MCL expiry

successor_law: If macro memory remains gross-negative, close this engine-profile branch. If gross-positive but friction-negative, use fixed-horizon MFE/MAE and CL/MCL auction anatomy to preregister a distinct oil-specific permission or lifecycle profile; never outcome-rescue these four cells.
